text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I pulled together the signal-pruning / alert-cleanup items. Can owners ack and confirm timelines?

mike: Ack. I can take rule cleanup for app-service alerts. Planning to scope in next sprint (2w).

yonah: I can own paging policy changes and dedupe rules. Need clarification: do we only dedupe identical stack fingerprints, or also by endpoint+error type?

raj: Question — for the persistent 500 spike alert, is the ask to raise the threshold or change from per-host to cluster-wide?

elaine: Good q. Proposal: change persistent-500 from host-count (>=3 hosts) to cluster-rate (>=0.8% of requests in 5m) + add minimum volume filter. That should cut noisy pages during low-traffic deploys.

mike: Sounds reasonable. I’ll update the rule and run it in staging. ETA: end of sprint week 1.

yonah: For dedupe: prefer fingerprint by (error_signature, stack_hash, route) — that groups noise but still pages distinct regressions. Will implement in paging policy and add a 10m suppression window for duplicate groups.

elaine: Perfect. Also add a small bake policy: if a new alert group spikes during a deploy window tagged by deploy-bot, suppress pages for first 10m and escalate to #deploys Slack instead. Would that be ok?

raj: That helps. I’ll adjust dashboards and set a separate chart for post-deploy noise. ETA: 3 days.

taylor: I’ll update the runbook with new ownership table and the canary/checklist for the paging change. Will also add an ops play for re-enabling pages if suppression hides a real outage. ETA: 1 week.

deploy-bot: rule-change: persistent-500 -> cluster-rate filter deployed to staging by mike at 2026-03-18T12:40Z :gear:

elaine: Action summary: mike = rule cleanup + staging validation (end of wk1), yonah = paging/dedupe + suppression windows (2w), raj = dashboards (3d), taylor = runbook + ops play (1w). I'll create the follow-up JIRA and tag owners. Please add any risks/blocked items here. :white_check_mark:

mike: Blocker: need test traffic generator for low-volume scenarios to validate min-volume filter. I’ll spin up a small script unless infra can provide.

yonah: I can help with test traffic; add me to the ticket.

elaine: Thanks — I'll create ticket REDWOOD-3456 and link tests, will ping infra for ephemeral load. Meeting end.
